title: Approximate tangent spaces of a subset agree a.e. with those of a locally finite superset (Lemma A)
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, H := μHE[k] on ℝ^N, and let E ⊆ E′ ⊆ ℝ^N be H-null-measurable sets with H(E′ ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^N. Then for H-a.e. x ∈ E (that is, H⌞E-a.e.) and every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^N: Q is the approximate tangent space of E at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E x Q: finrank Q = k and ∫_{η_{x,r}(E)} f dH → ∫_Q f dH as r → 0+ for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N), where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x)) if and only if Q is the approximate tangent space of E′ at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (E E' : Set (Eucl N)), E ⊆ E' → NullMeasurableSet E (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → NullMeasurableSet E' (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) (E' ∩ K) < ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict E), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E x Q ↔ Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E' x Q
